scope: Reuse of previously authorized exact digit-one-only mathbbm typography resolver after actual original comparison. No ordinary-one substitution or generalized aliases.

calls.literal_line: with $\mathbbm{1}_n$ equal to the $n\times n$ identity matrix. It defines the Poisson bracket

failure_behavior: Every argument other than literal1 raises PackageError.
font_dependency: Compile with installed named DejaVu Math TeX Gyre; final PDF embeds this font.
verification: All three original physical10 double-struck identity-matrix/prose one glyphs and their final output6 counterparts visually compared, with source literal mathbbm calls, n subscripts and surrounding matrix/prose unchanged. Standard fontspec no-math retains all other original math fonts.
